digest.component_or_area: completion verifier banking and verdict assembly
propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE incorrectly banks met=false (criterion unmet) when evidence exists but was not reached within the budget window, producing false FAIL verdicts.

The completion verifier must distinguish three evidence outcomes (met, refuted, insufficient_evidence) using a tri-state framework marker evidence_sufficient:false to carry exhaustion semantics separately from positive refutation.

The marker evidence_sufficient:false must be written exclusively by the framework's bounded fallback (never by the model tool) and preserved through record overwrites when harvest processes model output without the marker.

All verdict consumers (schema, banking, recovery, close gate, renderers, sidecar, audit page) must be updated to emit evidence_sufficient:false in messaging and payloads for insufficient-evidence FAILs, reporting exhaustion rather than unmet criteria.

The audit page ticket consumer discriminated PASS/FAIL by shape (presence of criteria key in sidecar), causing failure findings to vanish when FAIL payload now includes criteria; the consumer must key on the verdict field itself.
